title: TrustJudge: Inconsistencies of LLM-as-a-Judge and How to Alleviate Them
authors_zh: Yidong Wang，Yunze Song，Tingyuan Zhu，Xuanwang Zhang，Zhuohao Yu，Hao Chen，Chiyu Song，Qiufeng Wang，Zhen Wu，Xinyu Dai，Yue Zhang，Cunxiang Wang，Wei Ye，Shikun Zhang。
paper_type_zh: LLM-as-a-Judge 一致性与可靠性审计
best_for_zh: 构建、选择或审计 LLM-as-a-Judge 自动评测系统的研究者与工程团队。
one_line: Accepted study of judge inconsistency with public conference materials.
审计 LLM judge 的打分—比较冲突与成对传递性失效，并以概率推理降低不一致。
why: It adds a concrete reliability or failure-mode evaluation surface to Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13: contamination, verifier/reward failure, reward hacking, or evaluator reliability.

title: Problem
问题
html:
LLM-as-a-judge uses integer scores and pairwise choice, yet a lower-scored response can win head-to-head and pairwise verdicts can form cycles or contradictory ties. These defects make a judge’s ranking unreliable even when each individual prompt appears well formed.

TrustJudge is a probabilistic inference framework, not a newly trained judge. It preserves score distributions rather than one rounded score and resolves uncertain pairwise ties with likelihood information, then audits both inconsistency rates across judge families.

LLM-as-a-Judge 同时使用整数打分与成对比较，却可能自相矛盾：低分回答在直接比较中胜出，或成对判断形成循环、等价关系失传递。这会使看似逐题正常的评测产生不可靠排序，进而污染基准结论和偏好数据。

TrustJudge 不是训练新 judge，而是概率化推理框架：保留分数分布而非单个取整分，并以似然信息解决不确定的成对平局，再在多类 judge 上审计两种不一致率。

因此研究目标是修复评测接口内部的逻辑兼容性，而非只提高某一单项准确率。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: TrustJudge reframes reliability as consistency between two decision contracts. Distribution-sensitive scoring turns judge logits over an expanded scale into a softmax expectation, retaining entropy lost by a 1–5 integer. Likelihood-aware aggregation resolves ambiguous pairwise ties from bidirectional win/tie/lose probabilities or perplexity. The official code is available; the central artifact is the framework and inconsistency audit, not a standalone benchmark.

TrustJudge 将 judge 可靠性重述为两种决策契约的一致性。分布敏感打分把扩展尺度上的 logits 转成 softmax 期望，保留 1–5 整数分抹去的判断熵；似然感知聚合则以双向胜/平/负概率或序列困惑度拆解模糊平局。官方代码可用，核心产物是框架及不一致审计，而非独立 benchmark。

它的关键判断是：若先将概率压缩成离散标签，再比较标签，信息损失会系统性制造看似合理、却互相冲突的 verdict。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Measure conflicts. Flag score-pair disagreement as Conflict Ratio (CR); count circular or equality-transitivity violations in response sets as NTR.
  1. Score distributions. Prompt the judge on 5/10/100-point scales, softmax its token probabilities, and use the expected score rather than greedy integer decoding.
  1. Aggregate pairs. Obtain both answer orders; when ties remain, use bidirectional verdict likelihoods or lower perplexity to decide.
  1. Audit or optimize. Report CR, NTR, and accuracy across models/datasets; use the ordering for evaluation or DPO. Fix prompts, scale, tolerance, decoding probabilities and judge version to reproduce; small judges may fail the output format.

1. 度量冲突。 分数与成对判决不一致记为 Conflict Ratio（CR）；在回答集合中统计循环偏好或等价不传递的 NTR。
  1. 保留分布。 在 5/10/100 分尺度提示 judge，对 token 概率作 softmax，使用期望而非贪心整数分。
  1. 聚合回答对。 获取两个呈现顺序的判决；仍有平局时，以双向判决似然或较低困惑度决定。
  1. 审计或优化。 跨模型、数据集报告 CR、NTR 与准确率，再用于评测或 DPO。复现须固定提示词、尺度、容差、解码概率和 judge 版本；小 judge 可能无法遵循输出格式。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim. Preserving score uncertainty and breaking ambiguous ties reduces framework-level inconsistency.

Setup. Table 1 evaluates Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct on the authors’ single-score/pairwise tests, comparing the 5-scale baseline with TrustJudge; the method changes the scoring rule and pair aggregation, not the judge checkpoint.

Result. CR falls from 23.32% to 14.89%, and four-way NTR falls from 15.22% to 4.40%; exact-match accuracy rises from 51.77% to 64.22%.

Boundary. This supports the audited protocols and prompts, not a guarantee of human alignment or a cure for content-level judge bias; results still depend on the base model’s instruction following.

主张。 保留分数不确定性、拆解模糊平局能降低评测框架层的不一致。

设置。 表 1 用 Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct 在作者的单分/成对测试上比较 5 分基线与 TrustJudge；改变的是打分规则和成对聚合，不是 judge checkpoint。

结果。 CR 从 23.32% 降至 14.89%，四元 NTR 从 15.22% 降至 4.40%；exact-match 准确率从 51.77% 升至 64.22%。

边界。 证据支持被审计的协议与提示词，不能保证与人类一致或消除内容层 judge 偏差；仍依赖基础模型的指令遵循能力。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier judge work usually improves agreement, debiases one protocol, or trains another evaluator. TrustJudge instead treats the contradiction between scalar and pairwise contracts as the target, linking it to score information loss and ambiguous ties. Its new decision rule preserves the full score distribution and aggregates likelihoods; softmax, perplexity, and DPO themselves are not new.

既有 judge 工作多提升一致性、修正某一协议偏差，或训练另一评测器。TrustJudge 则把标量与成对契约的矛盾当作对象，归因于打分信息损失和模糊平局；新变化是保留完整分数分布并聚合似然的决策规则。softmax、困惑度和 DPO 本身并非新技术。

最近基线往往只比较准确率或单一偏差；本文把跨协议冲突率、成对非传递率作为与任务准确率并行的可靠性终点。

因此可定位排序失效来源。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Author-stated: TrustJudge depends on the underlying evaluator’s instruction following; smaller models can fail to return valid scores or comparisons, so the framework cannot repair a nonfunctional judge.

Curator audit: lower CR/NTR does not prove that a judge’s preferences are correct, fair, or robust to prompt injection. Before deployment, separately test human agreement, position/length bias, prompt compliance, and the cost of obtaining token probabilities or perplexity.

作者明确限制：TrustJudge 依赖底层评测模型的指令遵循能力；小模型可能无法输出有效分数或比较，因此框架不能修复失能 judge。

编者审计：较低 CR/NTR 不等于偏好正确、公平或抗提示注入。部署前仍要分别测人工一致性、位置/长度偏差、提示合规性，以及获取 token 概率或困惑度的成本。

若闭源接口不暴露所需概率，方法的可实施性会下降；不同任务的平局语义也需要预先界定。

这仍需审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this when an evaluation team has a judge that can expose next-token probabilities and needs a coherent score-plus-ranking contract. Input candidate responses and fixed prompts; run distributional scoring and bidirectional comparisons; output scores, pair verdicts, CR/NTR, and a final ordering. Success is lower inconsistency without loss on a target human-labeled set. Do not use it as a substitute for content, safety, or human-preference validation.

当评测团队的 judge 可暴露 next-token 概率、且需要一致的“分数+排序”契约时可用。输入候选回答和固定提示，运行分布式打分与双向比较，输出分数、成对判决、CR/NTR 和最终排序；在目标人工标注集上不降性能且冲突下降才算成功。不能替代内容、安全或人类偏好验证。

应同时保存提示、温度、概率可得性及平局处理规则，并对每个业务领域重新测量人工一致性。

以避免把协议改动误当模型进步。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: audits score-comparison and pairwise-transitivity inconsistency, then changes inference rather than training a new judge.
  2. Lever: preserve a 5/10/100-point token distribution; break ties with likelihood or perplexity.
  3. Artifact: official TrustJudge code is reported; no standalone new benchmark is claimed.
  4. Evidence: Llama-3.1-70B CR 23.32→14.89 and NTR 15.22→4.40 (Table 1); this is protocol-level evidence.
  5. Reuse: appropriate for judge pipelines with logprobs; first verify human agreement and weak-model format compliance.

1. 定位： 审计分数—比较冲突和成对传递性失效，再改推理规则而非训练新 judge。
  2. 方法抓手： 保留 5/10/100 分 token 分布；以似然或困惑度拆平局。
  3. 产物： 论文报告公开 TrustJudge 代码；未声称独立新 benchmark。
  4. 证据： Llama-3.1-70B 的 CR 23.32→14.89、NTR 15.22→4.40（表 1）；这是协议层证据。
  5. 复用： 适合能取得 logprob 的 judge 管线；先检验人工一致性与弱模型格式合规。
